verdict.rationale: Browserbase's own fetch capability is described as converting any URL into HTML, JSON or markdown, so it offers several output formats directly. The evidence is a single marketing line and does not show how a developer selects the format per request. missing for 10: documented per-request format selection parameter, plain-text output, frontmatter output, API reference detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose exactly which output format is returned, such as markdown, HTML, text, or frontmatter

citations.quote: Quickly fetch web context for your agent by converting any URL into HTML, JSON or markdown
